seen_val_sampling.sampling: seeded random episodes, reserved from all training rungs

episodes.task_description: A person carefully folds a black shirt on a patterned mat in a stockroom environment.

unseen_val.classification_note: User-reviewed MP4; task description describes folding a black shirt only.

flagship_unseen_val.selection_basis: 20 seeded random episodes per each of the four highest-volume operators; includes user-approved video episode 692eadb33b319da763b71ba6. SQL task_description is blank for these rows.

classification_policy: Candidate task IDs include folding_clothes/fold_clothes/folding_shirt/folding_t-shirt variants plus folding_laundry/pants/socks/trousers; include only descriptions explicitly mentioning folding and with no explicit hanging, ironing, sorting, packing, organizing, washing, buttoning, cleaning, spraying, or unrelated action. Stacking/placing folded items and using an ironing board as a work surface are allowed.

metric_sampling.notes: Fixed across rungs and validation passes; all frames of shorter episodes. Full predicted trajectory MSE excludes padding. Videos do not contribute to metrics.
